name: CITADEL
source:
[i]Light.
Brilliant, white light scatters across the surface of the primordial solution suspending my body.[/i]

You awake suspended in a warm, primordial soup with no idea who or where you are.
Breaking free from your watery dwelling, you find yourself in a secluded valley with no sign of life.
A path stretches out before you, illuminating three mysterious buildings and a giant looming tower.
Filled with an unmistakable curiosity, you venture out to the mighty CITADEL to discover the answers to your existence.

The path will not be easy.
There will be difficult choices to make, and harsh truths to accept.
Keep the future in mind as you stumble ahead into the darkness.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433910/CITADEL/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[i]光。
明亮的白光散布在悬浮着我身体的原液表面。[/i]你醒来时悬浮在温暖的原始汤中，不知道自己是谁或在哪里。
摆脱水上住所后，你发现自己身处一个僻静的山谷中，没有任何生命的迹象。
一条小路在你面前延伸，照亮了三座神秘的建筑和一座若隐若现的巨大塔楼。
带着明显的好奇心，你冒险前往强大的CITADEL，寻找你存在的答案。

这条路不会一帆风顺。
将会做出艰难的选择，并接受严酷的事实。
当你跌跌撞撞地走向黑暗时，请记住未来。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433910/CITADEL/]Steam[/url]]
